summary_text: On 2026-04-17 (weekday), a single order of 15 fresh vegetable items was placed in the afternoon. The basket comprised herbs (coriander, mint), leafy greens (methi, bhindi), root vegetables (beetroot, carrot, potatoes), and aromatics/condiments (onion, tomato, lemon). All items were unbranded. The afternoon timing aligns with a less typical window for vegetable replenishment compared to the population baseline (afternoon share 0.2526 vs. morning 0.3246 and evening 0.3027), suggesting a mid-day top-up or specific timing need rather than standard evening meal prep. As this is a single observation, it does not establish stable preferences or brand loyalty.
